description: This is a source file implementing an Android Fragment named HomeFragment using Kotlin. It builds a TV home screen with Leanback support, including a hero banner carousel, multiple content rows, and a custom top navigation bar. The file defines data models, presenters, and sample data for various UI components, and handles view creation, layout, and interactions.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that constructs the TV home screen with various content rows, a hero banner, and a custom navigation bar.

classes.name: NavItem
classes.description: Data class representing an item in the top navigation pill bar.

classes.name: BannerItem
classes.description: Data class representing a banner to display in the hero carousel.

classes.name: LandscapeItem
classes.description: Data class representing a landscape-oriented media item.

classes.name: BannerPresenter
classes.description: Presenter for displaying banner items in the hero carousel.

classes.name: LandscapeCardPresenter
classes.description: Presenter for displaying landscape media cards with focus effects.

classes.name: BannerItemDiff
classes.description: DiffUtil callback for efficiently updating banner items.

classes.name: LandscapeItemDiff
classes.description: DiffUtil callback for efficiently updating landscape items.

methods.name: HomeFragment.buildRows
methods.description: Constructs the content rows for the home screen including hero banner and content rails.

methods.name: HomeFragment.createHeader
methods.description: Creates header items for the content rows.

methods.name: HomeFragment.applyWindowInsets
methods.description: Applies insets to the container view to handle in-screen system UI areas.

methods.name: HomeFragment.onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events, particularly for navigation within the top nav view.

methods.name: BannerPresenter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds BannerItem data to the BannerView.

methods.name: LandscapeCardPresenter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates ViewHolder for landscape media cards.

methods.name: LandscapeCardPresenter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds LandscapeItem data to the LandscapeCardView.
